text: Jogitee onon Muumini en, Deftere nden e sunna on, wata on faggito ko senndata on. Annditee Neema Alla on e dow mooɗon tuma laatinoɗon anyandiruɓe ado lislaamu on, hara o warindira e famdude e sababuuji , O renndini ɓerɗe mon ɗen e lislaamu on, wontirɗon Ɓural Makko ngal siɗɗuɓe ka diina, yurmondirɓe wallindirooɓe. On laatinoke ko adii ɗum, ɓaɗtornooɓe naatugol yiite ngen fii keeferaaku mo'on; Alla Daɗndiri mon-nge sabu lislaamu on, O Fewniri on liimaanu. Ko wano Alla Ɓannginirani on nii ɗum ɗoo, O Ɓannginiraŋta on kon ko moƴƴinanta- on fiyakuuji mo'on aduna e laakara; fii yo on feewir e laawol peewal ngol, jokkon laawol foccii ngol ngol.
